_comment: Caps for rt-inbox-deliver.py, the UserPromptSubmit hook that hands a session the
messages the rt-observe dashboard left for it.
R0: these live here rather than in the hook so a machine can retune delivery without
editing Python. R4 provenance: CHOSEN on 2026-08-31, sized so a handful of short
operator notes reach a turn while a flooded inbox cannot fill a context window.
Setting enabled to false, deleting this file, or breaking its JSON disables delivery
in SILENCE and the hook still exits 0 (R11). That matters more here than anywhere
else in this repository: a UserPromptSubmit hook that exits non-zero refuses the
prompt itself, so a broken inbox would take the whole session with it.
